title: Capybara Merge: Tower Defense
shortDescription: Merge cute capybaras, blast zombie hordes, and defend your base in this fun TD!
fullDescription:
“The chillest capybaras are going full berserk!”

Welcome to Capybara Defenders—a hilarious, stress-relieving casual merge tower defense game! The usually zen and emotionally stable "capys" are gearing up to defend their home against endless hordes of zombies!

Whether you are commuting, taking a quick break, or winding down before bed, you can play easily with just one hand. Experience the ultimate satisfaction of clearing the entire screen of monsters!

【Game Features】

👉 Classic Merge & Evolve
Buy 'em and merge 'em! Simply drag and drop two capybaras of the same level to instantly evolve them into a super capy with massive firepower. The controls are incredibly easy—anyone can carry the game!

🛡️ Strategic Placement & Epic Defense
Face endless waves of massive zombie mobs! Position your frontline tanks and backline damage dealers strategically. Tap your ultimate "Tactical Missile" at the perfect moment to wipe out the enemies and turn the tide of battle.

🦄 Hilarious Cosplay Skins
Who knew capybaras loved to cosplay? Unlock wild and wacky skins: the righteous Bat-Bara, the dreamy Rainbow Unicorn, the quirky Caterpillar, and more! Each form not only looks ridiculous but also features completely unique shooting effects.

🚀 Endless Waves & Ultimate Satisfaction
Watch as your capybara squad's intense crossfire obliterates the zombie hordes in seconds. Enjoy the crazy damage numbers and the pure stress-relief of mowing down enemies. Challenge endless waves and break your own high scores!

🌟 Chill, Idle & Collect
No exhausting daily quests! Whip out your phone and play a quick round whenever, wherever. Satisfy your collector's itch with our comprehensive encyclopedia—come and unlock every single mysterious capybara form!

Join Capybara Defenders now! Team up with the chillest capys on earth and start this hilarious, stress-free defense battle!
